C0542.title: Woman Arrested for Repeated Malicious Refunds: Forged Addresses and Switched Goods in 121 Returns Totaling Over 20,000 Yuan
C0542.summary: In June 2026, a woman in Beijing was apprehended after initiating 121 malicious refunds across multiple e-commerce platforms by fabricating delivery addresses and swapping items, with the total amount involved exceeding 20,000 yuan. Police discovered a large quantity of unopened new clothing and complete return records at her residence, leading to her arrest on fraud charges.

references.title: Woman Caught for Repeated Malicious Refunds, Fraudulent Acts Violate the Law
